reviews.title: Only 5 stars so you can read this, I rate it 3 stars 🤷‍♀️
reviews.text:
Ok, I’m so sorry if this sounds mean but it’s not the best app! I mean, it is a good app, amazing in fact, but as soon as you’ve drawn the fish it makes you pay! So, if you wanna draw a fish with this app have fun, but not if you wanna draw anything else, it costs so much money! I drew the fish and it looked awesome but I don’t think it’s worth it. After drawing the fish, it made you move onto the panda, but when you click on to it, it comes up with the paywall. So, if you wanna pay for amazing drawings, have fun!  But, if you just wanna draw out if your imagination and safe money, DO NOT DOWNLOAD!! But also, it teaches you shading and all that in the free lesson so you can just use that skill that simply draw have given to you to draw better things! I did, I drew a sloth without simply draw, and it was so good! Better than the fish I’d say. And, I’m so sorry simply draw but I just don’t understand why you can’t just make it a free experience instead of making everyone pay?? I bet many people agree with this review, and that you should change the add to say ‘you need to pay 90 pounds!’ 
Thanks, ducky slothy capybaras lover

reviews.title: Honest review ⚡️
reviews.text: Hi! Please read this, as this is my honest review of this app. I downloaded this a few minutes ago, and deleted it after the fish (in the app). This is probably a great app for kids younger than 7 to have for fun- not really to improve. I say this because it teaches you exactly how to draw EXACTLY WHAT THEY WANT YOU TO DRAW. They do say that you have creativity, but it’s really limited. I’m far over 7 years old and downloaded the app to see if they could teach me to draw people, my one weakness being a really skilled painter. They started taking me through tutorials of simple animals for 5 year olds. It was slow-paced and boring. It wouldn’t let me check if there were courses to draw humans, it tried to make me draw SUPER EASY “advanced drawings.” Overall, just not for me. The entire process was kinda boring. I’m not just saying this because I am more skilled, I don’t recommend this app. Nobody else. I hope everyone’s experiences are better than mine, have fun, my friends!! Have a good day.⚡️Dear Creators/workers~~ your ads are annoying. Make it shorter or run it less. And maybe let people 12+ years old skip the fish and panda? Thank you so so much for your time and have a great work day.

reviews.title: Why you should only get it if you have money
reviews.text: This game might look fun at first because it promises drawing lessons and creative activities, but honestly you shouldn’t get it since it only gives you one free drawing lesson before everything else is locked behind payments, which can feel really frustrating and unfair, especially when you expect to learn and practice without constantly being asked to spend money; instead of helping you improve your drawing step by step, the app keeps pushing upgrades, subscriptions, and extra packs that make it seem like learning art is only possible if you pay, and that takes away the whole point of a drawing app that should encourage creativity, not pressure you to buy things, so it ends up feeling more like a money grab than a helpful tool because you download it excited to draw and quickly realize most of the features, lessons, and even simple tools are restricted, meaning you can’t fully explore or learn without spending money, which can be disappointing, annoying, and a waste of storage when there are other apps and ways to draw that are actually free, let you practice whenever you want, and focus on helping you get better instead of constantly reminding you to pay.

reviews.title: Money Scam.
reviews.text: I know, I know, you are probably asking “why is it a scam?” or “How would a drawing game be a scam?”. Well, I have a couple reasons. First off, when you download the game it seems fun and a great way to pass time. Or so you think. You go on to draw a beautiful and unique fish learning the basics of shading, then you finish with an amazing fish. You go to take a picture and snap a grate photo of your fish. Now let’s say you have big fins because the guy giving you a tutorial told you to be creative! You snap a photo and all the AI system got was some ruffs of the now sad fins and no tail, telling you only your shading was great. That is my first complaint which is super annoying to me. Then, upset you put it in the library hoping there is a way to retake the photo for feed back and edit the bio. Now the guy with the tutorial tells you to draw a panda! Great! The panda you saw in every ad! You press the arrow button to start and it gives you an odd message. Not just any message. A subscription page. You look at the top right corner and see a bolt like bar with a zero. You have to pay to learn to draw on an app with ads saying it was FREE. Not only do I have to pay but for a drawing app? I am only giving it 5 stars because it might pop up somewhere you can see first. *1 star* If you want to pay thats okay but for $80 a year is just a waist. There are plenty of other learn to draw apps that help you SAVE money. I don’t know what I was expecting from this app but I am indeed disap
